status: Development only. Frozen before opening native bank or measuring development outcomes. No validation authorized here.

01.opportunities: All 24000 undirected nearest-neighbor edges per 20^3 parent, represented once by the positive axes. Equivalent to averaging both signs of uniform oriented edges. Retain exactly one occupied end and equality of the two exterior counts at squared distances 1,2,3, both endpoints omitted. No species beyond known global N_A=2400, no fit, no cap, no orientation filter.
01.score: ln[2 P(realized placement)] from the exact canonical species-summed partition at the supplied temperature. Every eligible edge has equal weight; full denominator includes exact forecast ties. Fold sign for calibration: compare actual occupation of the higher-weight end with p_max, assigning half at exact ties.
01.advancement: Only 01 may be primary. At cold train require >=128 independent parents with nontrivial opportunities (p_max>=.55), parent-clustered two-sided 95% gain lower endpoint >=.01 nat/eligible, full 95% interval of mean favored-end calibration residual inside [-.03,.03], and beta-zero exact tie. If supported, publicly lock once before issuing native index 7 validation for this NEW edge contrast. No existing validation cohort is historically virgin. Same gain floor, cluster uncertainty, beta-zero development null and calibration/support requirements on transfer. No retest.
01.uncertainty: Ratio of sums of parent numerators to parent opportunity counts; t_(P-1) interval with linearized residuals including zero-denominator parents. Intervals are empirical, whole-parent clustered, not edge-binomial. Physical interpretation is for this archive, L and temperature; violation only for isotropic translation-invariant vacancy pair models restricted to squared radii 1,2,3, not all pair models.
01.pattern: Without conditioning on the realized end, describe the modal distinct unordered pair of five-neighbor exterior degree spectra (occupied neighbors only), among p_max>=.55. Each occupied exterior neighbor of a filled end is promoted k->k+1, candidate degree fixed across placements. Report favored direction and observed frequency for that pattern; descriptive not a new success criterion.
01.historical_distinction: Missing placement of one vacancy across an edge with equal three-shell pair counts; not decoration on a supplied mask, nor selection among matched cage-arm tripods/T.

02.population: All 24000 4x4 windows per periodic 20^3 parent (three coordinate-plane orientations). Exhaustive finite 2^16 mask table; exact signed aperiodic vector displacement multiplicities for EVERY dx,dy in [-3,3], including zero. Deduplicate D4 and translations. Match tight boxes and register to a COMMON orientation of the full vector table, not radial bins. Score external face in the translated tight box at both +/-3 normal layers (two intervening); fraction of in-plane nearest-neighbor bonds with two vacancies, pooled over the two sides. This is ONE measurement invariant to residual D4 frame ambiguities. Fixed registration to tight box not the padded window.
02.selection: Use ONLY index-9 training shape frequencies, never the target or code scores, to select one genuinely nonequivalent pair by largest minimum number of contributing parents then largest minimum occurrence count, then largest total count, then sorted representative word IDs. Require >=128 distinct parents per shape and >=1024 windows per shape before examining physical target. If no support stop with frequency and parent-level limit, no relaxed homometry. For supported pair practical floor is absolute difference 0.01 vacancy-bond fraction; exploratory only, no claim from selecting best of 15. Interval for difference clusters both classes within parent. A hypothetical independent contrast needs a new public lock.
02.code: A single frozen 2^3 species LUT has only a 2x2 cross-section and sees one adjacent plane too. No assertion it encodes which 4x4 mask occurred. Compare actual, identically registered local readouts only on supported observed windows; dense spatial vector of symbols is a different variable, not a single fitted map.
02.historical_distinction: Exact full-vector diffraction degeneracy of a planar occupancy patch vs a remote same-box bond statistic, not recurrent patch frequency, a face prediction score or a finite Fourier summary.
